historical_record.description: The State-owned property, with 350-foot frontages on Evans and Davidson Streets and 200 feet on Rankin Street, was an open fenced yard with a small office building and several one-storey storage buildings used by a building-wrecking contractor to store equipment. The City Planning Commission unanimously approved, with eleven conditions, an automobile dismantling and parts-sales business on the block bounded by Evans, Davidson and Rankin Streets and the Southern Embarcadero Freeway.
